rationale: Default channel_index=8 (ret_5d_xrank, a [0,1] cross-sectional rank) gave Sundial a non-TS-shaped input, collapsing scores to thr=0.0 on 6/7 windows. Train mode should sweep channel_index in {0, 1, 23} (atr_pct, volume_ratio, set_ret_5d_zscore_60d — real continuous TS) plus pos_weight in [0.8, 1.5] and use_tabular_features True/False before declaring dead. W1 sweep alive (thr=0.4 with +7.1% ann/33% WR) shows latent discrimination.
